semiconductor_relevance: High — JT Corporation supplies essential equipment and components for semiconductor manufacturing, including valves and flow control systems.
summary: JT Corporation specializes in providing equipment, parts, and chemicals for the semiconductor and flat panel display industries. Their offerings include various types of valves, gas filters, and measurement systems that enhance manufacturing processes and ensure product quality.

regional_presence.Korea: The company has been supplying its products to semiconductor and equipment manufacturers in Korea and globally.
